name: Kagami Hotaru
source:
Sara's younger sister.
Although she comes from a prestigious family of retired swordsmen, she has no talent for it, and was shunned. Despite this, she is talented in healing. She is quiet and shy, and has a strong desire to help others. She adores her sister, who mutually love and help each other out.
